answer: Continuous resource-budget ledger. Each identity must continuously spend a scarce physical input — metered compute or bandwidth — to keep emitting its signal, and every submission carries a unique marble-like nonce tied to that metered draw. The ledger enforces that a zephyr of activity cannot be sustained without drawing real capacity the operator does not own at scale. An attacker must provision distinct metered hardware per identity, paying full marginal cost per fake.
